assetsPurpose: Exact official Inter/brand/vector geometry for native reconstruction; assets may have independent licenses.

licenseNotes.IconsAndBrand: Recovered from official served client assets; no explicit provider/license header was found in the shipped icon module. User confirmed port rights. No unverified provider attribution added.
licenseNotes.TwemojiFlags: Not copied to application assets because separate provenance/license was not resolved.
licenseNotes.FontCoverage: Only Latin variable font registered. Latin-ext staging font has same PostScript name and was intentionally not co-registered. German glyphs verified with CoreText.
